name: Перенести весь комплект целиком
text: the entire outfit — every visible piece of clothing and footwear, top and bottom — is transferred onto the target subject, fully replacing all of their original clothing; the target subject's face, hair, and body are not altered — only their clothing changes

name: Перенести только стиль одежды
text: only the general style category of the outfit is referenced as inspiration — not the exact garments, cut, or colors
